title: St. John's Villa seeks return of stolen Bigfoot signs
excerpt: The Carrollton organization says the handmade signs promoted fundraising events for adults with developmental disabilities.
content:
Carrollton organization asks for the return of handmade event signs supporting adults with developmental disabilities

St. John’s Villa in Carrollton is asking for the return of several handmade Bigfoot signs that were recently stolen from locations around the community.

The signs were created to promote community events that raise money to support adults with developmental disabilities served by St. John’s Villa, 701 Crest St. in Carrollton.

Villa officials said the signs require significant time and effort to make and were displayed with permission from property owners. They expressed concern that continued thefts could affect whether the organization creates and displays similar signs for future events.

Anyone with information about the missing signs, or anyone who can help have them returned, is asked to call St. John’s Villa at 330-627-9789.

Bigfoot silhouettes also will be available to order during the organization’s events.
